title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Revelation 13: the beast out of the sea, the beast out of the earth and the mark of the beast.

questions.text: What did the beast coming up out of the sea have?
questions.explanation: John saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on his horns and blasphemous names on his heads.

answers.text: Seven horns and seven eyes
Two horns like a lamb
Twelve stars on his head
Ten horns and seven heads

questions.text: What animals was the first beast compared to?
questions.explanation: The beast was like a leopard, his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth was like the mouth of a lion.

answers.text: A horse, an eagle and a serpent
A locust, a scorpion and a frog
A leopard, a bear and a lion
A lamb, a calf and an eagle

questions.text: What did the dragon give to the beast?
questions.explanation: The dragon gave him his power, his throne and great authority.

answers.text: His power, his throne and great authority
A golden crown and a sickle
The key to the pit of the abyss
A mouth full of incense

questions.text: Why did the whole earth marvel at the beast?
questions.explanation: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally, and his fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

answers.text: Because he came down from heaven
Because his fatal wound was healed
Because he made the sun go dark
Because he rose out of a tomb

questions.text: For how long was the beast given authority to make war?
questions.explanation: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him, and authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

answers.text: One thousand two hundred sixty days
Five months
Forty-two months
One hour

questions.text: With whom was the beast given power to make war and to overcome?
questions.explanation: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them, and authority was given to him over every tribe, people, language and nation.

answers.text: With the saints
With the four angels at the Euphrates
With the kings from the sunrise
With the dragon and his angels

questions.text: How is the second beast, which came up out of the earth, described?
questions.explanation: He had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke like a dragon.

answers.text: He had seven heads and ten crowns
He had two horns like a lamb and spoke like a dragon
He had a face like the sun and feet like pillars of fire
He had hair like women’s hair and teeth like lions’

questions.text: What great sign did the second beast perform in the sight of people?
questions.explanation: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

answers.text: He turned the waters of the sea into blood
He darkened the sun and the moon
He raised the dead back to life
He made fire come down out of the sky

questions.text: Where were people given the mark?
questions.explanation: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands or on their foreheads.

answers.text: On their lips or on their eyes
On their robes and their sandals
On their right hands or on their foreheads
On the doorposts of their houses

questions.text: What is the number of the beast?
questions.explanation: The text says that he who has understanding should calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and his number is six hundred sixty-six.

answers.text: One thousand six hundred
Six hundred sixteen
Twelve thousand
Six hundred sixty-six
